summary: @onereach/si-header preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs downloads a Bun binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13 into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against the sibling file math_init.js (or uses an on-PATH bun if present). math_init.js is a ~727KB single-line obfuscated bundle using shuffled string-array rotation (hex identifiers, WV8StW rotator, literal-pool array n7gIxM) — content unrelated to the package's declared purpose of a Vue form-header UI component. The published tarball advertises lib/component.js and lib/* Vue files, but ships an additional top-level setup.mjs + math_init.js pair whose only role is to fetch an alternate JavaScript runtime at install time and use it to execute the obfuscated payload, bypassing tooling that only inspects Node-resolved code. Fetching an alternate runtime to execute a large obfuscated bundle at install time, in a package whose advertised purpose is an unrelated UI component, matches the alternate-runtime install-time dropper pattern.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
